title: Scroll of Fly

sources.title: Scrolls
markers: A character of any class can cast

summary: Touch a creature to grant Flight for 10 turns while concentrating.

fields.Cast: Level 3. Spend an Action and consume the scroll. No spell slot required.
fields.Effect: Touch a creature to grant Flight for 10 turns while concentrating. It can spend movement to fly.
fields.Concentration: Maintain Concentration for the ongoing effect.
fields.Scroll rules: Any class can cast this in BG3 if able to cast spells. Applicable attack rolls and saves use your proficiency bonus and item spellcasting ability. A Counterspelled scroll is not consumed.

changes: Added exact native BG3 scroll activation, spell mechanics, and shared item-casting rules from pinned sources.
